integrity: Full mathematical proof is self-contained; code supplies finite corroboration only; arXiv v1 posting supplies the verified source date.
scientific_limitations: Applies to finite unit-edge tree factors and commuting metric-retraction-induced Schauder projections, not weighted tree products or arbitrary linear bases; equivalence to an unindexed graph-folding theorem remains a bibliographic risk.
title: Sharp retractional constants for finite Cartesian products of trees
